character.name: Idle
character.prompt: Dark fantasy greater specter, the tormented spirit of an adult warrior who died violently and cannot rest. Tall, imposing floating apparition with a broad spectral upper body, elongated claw-like hands and a shredded lower half fading into supernatural mist. A distorted humanoid face with hollow glowing eyes and an expression of eternal anguish. Its silhouette suggests a powerful former human, now twisted by suffering. Torn spectral remnants surround its shoulders and torso. Cold gray, faded blue, pale violet and muted white palette. Menacing, tragic and supernatural, not a conventional zombie. Authentic 16-bit SNES pixel art inspired by Castlevania. Large crisp pixels, dark outlines, limited palette, 2–3 shading tones, readable silhouette. Full-body idle sprite, three-quarter view, transparent background, no scenery.
